title: Knowledge Digester adapter: datasets
requested_outcome: Context: the Knowledge Digester (docs/product-memory/KNOWLEDGE_DIGESTER_V1.md on the trunk; SOURCE_ASSIMILATION_V1.md) turns any external artifact into provenance-tagged, reversible Units. Its model is in app/digest/model.py in this base commit (Unit with artifact_id, kind from UNIT_KINDS, title, body of at most MAX_BODY characters, a Location of path and line span, and tags). This objective adds one adapter, the stage that decomposes a quarantined artifact into Units. Adapter contract, shared by every adapter: a module in app/digest/adapters/ (a namespace package: do not create app/digest/adapters/__init__.py, sibling objectives add their own adapters there) exposing NAME (a short string), HANDLES (a tuple of plain-word artifact kinds it understands) and decompose(root: Path, artifact_id: str) -> list[Unit], which reads only (never executes, imports or installs anything it reads), bounds file sizes and counts, returns Units in a deterministic order with exact locations, and never raises on malformed input (it skips what it cannot parse and says so in a Unit of kind knowledge tagged 'unparsed' with the reason). Standard library only. Build app/digest/adapters/data.py for datasets: CSV and TSV (with the csv module and dialect sniffing), JSON arrays, JSON Lines, and SQLite databases opened strictly read-only through a file URI with mode=ro and immutable=1. Each table or file becomes a data_schema Unit: columns, inferred types (integer, number, boolean, date, datetime, text), row count (bounded scan), null rate and distinct-count estimates. Columns that look like personal data (email addresses, phone numbers, postal codes, names) are tagged 'personal' and their values never appear in any Unit; for other columns at most three short example values are kept. Nothing is written back. Tests in tests/test_digest_adapter_data.py build fixtures in tmp_path covering every case named here, prove determinism, bounded sizes and that malformed input yields an 'unparsed' Unit rather than an exception. You cannot run commands: the loop runs the listed checks after you report and returns any failure output, and the independent review returns its findings, to your next attempt. Do not report an owner decision for GitHub acceptance: it runs automatically after your candidate is published.
acceptance_criteria: CSV, TSV, JSON, JSON Lines and read-only SQLite become data_schema Units with types, counts and null rates
personal columns are tagged and their values never appear
the adapter follows the shared contract: read-only, bounded, deterministic, never raising on malformed input
every listed check passes in the worker's workspace
